description: the plate of nurbs-slot-plate-rim-fillet, written by tools/oracle/occt_nurbs_blend.py: the slot's top rim chamfered at d 0.25 from its line on y = 2. The chain runs on at two tangent vertices, (5, 2, 2) and (5, 4, 2), through the half circle on the NURBS face into the line on y = 4: a table stripe, a walked stripe (ADR-0062) and a table stripe, meeting on the chords in the planes x = 5 (ADR-0035 §3), each line's far end cut by the plate's face x = 10 (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 7). Open CASCADE's contact on the NURBS round end misses the chord d by 2.9e-7 at the median, so its measures lie 2.5e-9 relative from Arris'. The measure tolerances cover that miss (ADR-0062, a walked fixture)
